understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through KA59’s levels by arranging the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied at the same time; a level is only won when all goal tiles are simultaneously covered by selectables, and the game is won after completing all levels within the step budgets.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn controls the currently selected piece (identified by player.id/position) on a grid where coordinates are given in pixel units (3 pixels per cell). MOVE actions attempt to shift the selected piece one cell in the chosen direction; movement can be prevented by walls/boundaries or other blocking objects, and the movement_blocked flags are only hints and not definitive. If a pushable object is directly adjacent in the move direction, the selected piece can push it so both shift, subject to collisions. When multiple selectable pieces exist, CLICK with a target_position matching another selectable’s pixel coordinate switches which piece is controlled.
